zeus-monitor collect --once.note: the store is wrapped read-only (put raises); Redis use is exists/xinfo/xlen only; stdout is empty: parity is the exit code. Per revision (RH-4d): the file writes are bounded to the declared_writes, all under the copy's runtime directory (`runtime_dir()`: monitor.py:main mkdirs it, run_collector opens only its log and lock there and the snapshot is written to <runtime>/monitoring.json through a .tmp and os.replace); no control-store or Redis write exists, so D1 == D0 holds. 5aa220fd and ec8aa0a2 predate the lane resolvers (their collect() takes no lanes: the control store only); 08bb9a44 and 1b9d746c read each registered lane through LaneSnapshotStore (REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, always rolled back, put refused)
